en.hubeali:
He said, ‘And it has been narrated to me by Ali Bin Hassan, from Musa Bin Bakr, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
Cause the sustenance to descend by the charity’.
en.sarwar: 4. The narrator of the above Hadith has said that Ali ibn Hassan narrated to me from Musa ibn Bakr who has said the following: “Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Make the means of sustenance descend to you by giving charity.’”
